content.text:
Long ago, a crater now known as Newporte was created when a large object collided with
Earth.

Impact craters, like Newporte in the United States, are formed when a massive object collides
with Earth, creating depressions in the land.

Researchers have investigated the formation of Newporte, an ancient impact crater measuring
$3.2 \mathrm{km}$ in diameter located in the United States.

When a large object struck what is now the United States less than 500 million years ago, it
created Newporte, a massive crater measuring $3.2 \mathrm{km}$ in diameter.
